package: WP-T9 v3b: re-run of v3 after a native bug fix in the scoped guard
why: v3 result (bench-results/selective-delivery-v3-20261021) showed foreign firing in the combined arm that the last-user scope should block. Cause: the embedding hook of v13_memory_hook.h also inserts every decoded prompt chunk into the guard context, so natively the scope only held for the cached prefix. Fixed: with explicit_ctx and scope_mark>=0 only generated tokens (n==1) join. Torch path was correct. v3 verdicts stay as recorded; v3 measured guard_distinct with an ineffective native scope.
traces: the two v3 trace artifacts reused byte-identically (v1 and fix .bin, same hashes as the v3 report binding); only the native binary changes
decision_rule: identical to code/docs/proofs/selective-delivery-v3-20261021/preregistration.json (H1 KEY_SEPARATION_SUPPORTED, H2 SELECTIVE_WINS_CANDIDATE); reported in addition: foreign-firing rows of combined and selective vs v3
expectation: combined and selective foreign firing drop clearly; trace arms unchanged (no fact words in the system prompt); H2 may still fail on paraphrase values
single_run: No re-run with changed settings counts as this attempt; a FAIL stays a FAIL.
hardware: Linux x86_64 cloud CPU, 4 threads; not Redmi
